description: Enforce a data contract at materialization — schema (per-column types/nullability/uniqueness/range/enum/regex), freshness SLA (max lag from prior materialization via event log), row-count SLA (drop% vs prior via event log). Emits one AssetCheckResult per contract rule + AssetObservation tagged with contract_version + owners + consumers. Contract version drives `code_version` on the asset so downstream can automatically invalidate on version bumps. Two shapes: this YAML component defines a new asset; the `@data_contract` decorator wraps an existing @dg.asset. on_violation=block raises dg.Failure (asset does not materialize); on_violation=warn materializes anyway, downstream blocks via AutomationCondition.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset emitting the DataFrame + N AssetCheckResults (schema + freshness + SLA). Metadata: contract_version, contract_row_count, contract_owners, contract_consumers, contract_check_summary, all_passed.
